scope: Observability review for PR267. Separate follow-ups are recorded outside the queue and event propagation scope.
framework_contract: GoForj owns tracing SDK integration. Shared libraries expose context-aware operations and transport metadata where application execution crosses a message boundary.

surfaces.current: WithContext forwards the caller context to backend operations and observers; framework observations emit client spans under that context.
surfaces.follow_up: Refresh-ahead replaces the execution context with Background for metadata, loader and writes while retaining request context for locks. Review background lifetime, parent correlation and cleanup separately.

surfaces.current: Bound contexts reach contextual drivers and framework observers. Synchronous copy reuses that context.
surfaces.follow_up: The framework observedStorage wrapper hides optional ObjectStorage streaming capabilities. Add a separate capability-preservation regression and fix.

surfaces.current: Send(ctx) preserves context through drivers and observers; framework emits client spans. Queued mail should use the queue propagation boundary.
Periodic runs start their own execution spans. Jobs dispatched from a run should continue that run through the queue carrier.
Query observers use the supplied GORM context and framework emits client spans.
The framework instrumented HTTPClient uses the active context and W3C headers. Callers must use it and pass their execution context for downstream propagation.

data_rule: Do not persist request trace identity in cache values or storage object contents. Later requests reuse those resources under their own traces.
